A [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] '''apprentice''' served under [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]] [[Darth Howl]], but was replaced by [[Eldon Ax]] after Howl became dissatisfied with her. According to Darth Howl she liked to keep pets. She posesessed at least 9 of these pets that [[Darth Howl]] and [[Eldon Ax]] shot on shight from [[Darth Howl's hunting range]].

She was kept in [[Darth Howl]]'s observation dome directly above the [[Darth Howl's hunting range|hunting range]] in order to torture her from failing her Master by killing her <nowiki>''pets'' to ''entertain guests''</nowiki>.
